title: bug: both launchers drop a deleted team's id only when the join_team refusal starts with "Team not found: ", but the daemon's coded refusal reads "[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: <id>", so a seat whose team was deleted keeps retrying the dead id and stays teamless until relaunched (the test fixture refuses unprefixed, so its "gone" case passes falsely)
description:
Found by architect-24611a0a while planning task-3962d9a0 (msg-565108d0, 20:24Z on 2026-11-03). The governor re-checked every line at 677d051a.

PROBLEM. When a seat's team id no longer exists (a team deleted through /ws DELETE_TEAM), both launchers mean to drop the id so the next retry re-creates the team by name. The branch never fires, because it matches a prefix the daemon never sends. The seat retries the dead id on every pre-flight and stays teamless until a human relaunches it.

EVIDENCE (at 677d051a):
- scripts/moe-agent.sh:2571 `case "$failure" in "Team not found: "*) TEAM_ID="" ;; esac`. $failure is the RPC error's `message`, verbatim (the python reader just above, about :2556).
- scripts/moe-agent.ps1:2006 `if ($failure.StartsWith('Team not found: ')) { $script:teamId = '' }`.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/joinTeam.ts:68 `throw notFound('Team', params.teamId)`. util/errors.ts:112-116 builds the message "Team not found: <id>". The MoeError constructor (errors.ts about :71-73) prefixes it to "[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: <id>": TEAM_NOT_FOUND is not in SPECIFIC_NOT_FOUND_CODE_NAMES (:44-49), so codeName is NOT_FOUND. McpAdapter.ts:318-323 sends toolError.message unchanged, with data { tool, codeName }.
- scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs:56: the fake proxy's 'gone' outcome refuses with the unprefixed 'Team not found: ' + teamId, so the case at :272 (joins ['gone','ok']) passes against the broken match.

FIX DIRECTION. In both twins, match the real refusal. Prefer error.data.codeName NOT_FOUND on join_team if the RPC helper exposes it; otherwise a substring match on "Team not found: ". Make the fixture refuse with the daemon's real coded shape: the message "[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: <id>", plus data.codeName if the helper reads it.

PLACEMENT (worktree mode, no dependsOn). The CQ-M07 VM lane also has moe-agent.{sh,ps1} open: n3 23c803d2 is WORKING, then n2 d861f3de and n 62ec51f1. Its hunks sit at ps1 line 3195 and later and sh line 9497 and later, over 1000 lines from :2006 and :2571, so a minimal edit lands cleanly by merge-tree.
- Keep the edit to the two match branches and the fixture. Don't reflow nearby code.
- Edit with the seat's own editor (Claude Edit/Write, or apply_patch on a codex exec seat), never a temp file plus mv.
- Gate: `node scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs` (it drives the real bash, PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 pre-flight segments), plus `bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh`, the ParseFile check on moe-agent.ps1, and scripts/tests/parity-check.sh. There is no full postflight run.
definitionOfDone: In both scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1, the drop-the-team-id branch fires on the daemon's real join_team refusal ("[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: <id>", or error.data.codeName NOT_FOUND), so a seat whose team was deleted re-creates the team by name on its next retry.

scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs's fake proxy refuses 'gone' with the real coded shape. Its 'gone' case passes on the fixed wrappers and fails on 677d051a's wrappers (a negative control is shown), for bash and every PowerShell engine available on the gate host.

bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh, the ParseFile check on scripts/moe-agent.ps1 and scripts/tests/parity-check.sh pass, and the wrapper diff stays inside the two match branches (the fixture is the only other file).

implementationPlan.description:
Tests first: repair and harden the fixture, then watch the gone row go RED. Make three edits in scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs with your Edit tool, never a shell write. Read mem:gotcha-wrapper-slice-tests-execute-text first.
(a) Line 91, SEGMENTS.ps1.funcs: change the end anchor '\nif ($Team) {' to '\nif ($Team -and -not $moeMigration) {'. d6cbb405 (WT-10M, 2026-11-02) rewrote that line (now scripts/moe-agent.ps1:1774), so between() throws 'missing boundaries' at module load. TODAY THE WHOLE SUITE FAILS on every engine, and so does CI's build-all-platforms step that lists it. Use the exact new line and do not loosen the anchor: slice anchors stay exact, so a moved line fails loudly.
(b) Line 56, FAKE_PROXY join_team 'gone' outcome: answer with the daemon's real coded refusal instead of refuse(): `if (outcome === 'gone') return reply({ error: { code: -32001, message: '[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: ' + args.teamId, data: { tool: 'moe.join_team', codeName: 'NOT_FOUND' } } });`. MoeErrorCode.NOT_FOUND is -32001, and McpAdapter.ts:318-323 sends data { tool, codeName }. Leave every other outcome as it is, 'error' included.
(c) Assertions. In the row 'a seat whose team was deleted re-creates it by name on the next pre-flight' (about :271), add two lines.
- After its tools(run, 1) assertion: `assert.match(run.out, /MOE_SEAT_UNREGISTERED worker=worker-fixture team=Workers - moe\.join_team: \[NOT_FOUND\] Team not found: team-fixture;/);`. It pins that the coded message reaches the seat, so the fixture cannot silently go back to unprefixed.
- After its tools(run, 2) assertion: `assert.deepEqual(run.rpcs.find((r) => r.iter === 2 && r.tool === 'create_team').args, { name: 'Workers' });`.
In the refused re-join loop (about :251-260), after its tools(run, 1) assertion, add `assert.ok(!tools(run).includes('create_team'), 'only a deleted team drops its id');`. It guards against a match that fires on every refusal.
RED: from the task worktree root run `node --test scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs`. Expect 58 tests: 19 pass, 1 fail ('bash: a seat whose team was deleted ...', at the tools(run, 2) assertion, where actual starts with 'join_team') and 38 PowerShell skips. The architect's scratch run reproduced exactly this.

Fix both match branches and nothing else. Edit in place in the task worktree with your Edit tool, which leaves a TOOL witness. Never use a temp file plus mv, and never sed -i.
- scripts/moe-agent.sh:2571 (retry_team_join): change `case "$failure" in "Team not found: "*) TEAM_ID="" ;; esac` to `case "$failure" in *"Team not found: "*) TEAM_ID="" ;; esac`.
- scripts/moe-agent.ps1:2006 (Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry): change `if ($failure.StartsWith('Team not found: ')) { $script:teamId = '' }` to `if ($failure.Contains('Team not found: ')) { $script:teamId = '' }`. Contains is ordinal and case-sensitive, like the bash glob.
- In both files, directly below the existing comment `# A team deleted under the seat: drop its id so the next retry re-creates it by name.`, add the same one line: `# The daemon's refusal reads "[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: <id>", so match inside it, not at its start.`
Error handling contract (unchanged apart from the match):
- This branch is the join retry's refusal path. Only a refusal whose message contains 'Team not found: ' drops the cached id.
- Every other failure keeps the id and is retried as before: a full team, isError, a malformed, foreign or unlisted answer, 'no answer', or a create_team failure.
- The MOE_SEAT_UNREGISTERED / TEAMLESS warning still prints once per changed refusal.
- $failure is never null in ps1 ([string] cast, '' initially), so .Contains cannot throw.
Why a substring match rather than error.data.codeName:
- bash's python reader inside retry_team_join (about :2538-2559) keeps only error.message, so using codeName would widen the diff past the branch, which DoD 3 forbids.
- NOT_FOUND is not specific to teams.
- The codeName would become TEAM_NOT_FOUND if errors.ts SPECIFIC_NOT_FOUND_CODE_NAMES ever lists it, while notFound('Team', id)'s text stays 'Team not found: <id>'.
Keep moe-agent.ps1's UTF-8 BOM (first bytes ef bb bf). Then run `bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh`. The CQ-M07 lane edits these files far below this point (ps1 3195+, sh 9497+), so merge-tree takes both. Touch nothing else.

Verification, run once. See mem:gotcha-launcher-ps1-rows-from-wsl. From the task worktree root, in a normal shell, run the gate below. Do not use env -i: node.exe needs the Windows PATH for python and Git Bash, and WSL MOE_* variables don't reach it.
`bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh && node --test scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs && "/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test "$(wslpath -w scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs)" && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh`
Expected results:
- WSL leg: 58 tests, 20 pass, 0 fail, 38 skipped.
- Windows leg: 58 tests, 58 pass, 0 skipped. Its 'PowerShell 5.1: moe-agent.ps1 parses' and 'PowerShell 7: moe-agent.ps1 parses' rows are DoD 3's ParseFile check.
- 'PASS parity-check.sh' (about 6 s).
This output, run fresh, is complete_task's verification.
Then run the negative control on 677d051a's wrapper bytes (DoD 2). Shell writes go only to scratch outside the checkout:
`S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/neg-6b8f-XXXXXX) && git archive 677d051a scripts .github/workflows/ci.yml | tar -x -C "$S" && cp scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs "$S/scripts/tests/" && (cd "$S" && node --test scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs; "/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test "$(wslpath -w scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs)"); rm -rf -- "$S"`
Expected results:
- WSL: 1 fail (the bash 'gone' row), 19 pass, 38 skipped.
- Windows: 3 fail (the Git Bash, PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 'gone' rows), 55 pass.
- Every failure is at the tools(run, 2) assertion: the old wrappers retry the dead id.
Quote both RED summaries in complete_task's summary. The architect's scratch run at 677d051a matched every count (RED 1 and 3 fails; GREEN 20 pass with 38 skipped, and 58/58).

Adversarial self-review of your own `git diff` in the worktree. Fix any finding, re-run step 3's gate, and only then call complete_task.
(1) Scope: exactly three files. Each wrapper hunk is the match line plus the one comment line, and the twins' comment text is identical.
(2) Fixture: only the anchor, the 'gone' reply and the three assertions changed. 'error' still refuses with the unprefixed 'Team Workers is full (max 1 members)'. That is out of scope: the wrappers print that text and never branch on it.
(3) False positives: the substring fires only on a message that contains 'Team not found: '. A team NAME containing that text would make a full-team refusal drop the id. The cost is one idempotent create_team by name per retry, and nothing else.
(4) moe-agent.ps1 still starts with ef bb bf (parity-check fails otherwise).
(5) Nothing new: no state, concurrency or IO. The variables are per seat, and moe_rpc and Invoke-MoeRpcRaw are untouched.
Would you be embarrassed if a deleted team still left a seat teamless? Step 3's RED/GREEN pair is the proof that it does not.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: When moe.join_team is refused because the seat's cached team id no longer exists, both launchers clear that id. The daemon's refusal message is "[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: <id>". On the next pre-flight the seat re-creates the team by name with moe.create_team and joins it, instead of retrying the dead id until a human relaunches it. Every other refusal keeps the id. scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs loads again, because its ps1 slice anchor follows d6cbb405's team-setup line. Its fake proxy refuses 'gone' with the daemon's real coded error.
acceptanceCriteria: bash retry_team_join drops TEAM_ID when $failure contains 'Team not found: ' anywhere: case pattern *"Team not found: "*.
ps1 Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry drops $script:teamId when $failure.Contains('Team not found: '), which is ordinal and case-sensitive like the bash glob.
The fake proxy's 'gone' outcome replies { code: -32001, message: '[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: <teamId>', data: { tool: 'moe.join_team', codeName: 'NOT_FOUND' } }.

The 'gone' row checks four things: the coded refusal appears in the MOE_SEAT_UNREGISTERED line; iteration 2 runs create_team({ name: 'Workers' }), join_team, then chat_channels; registered goes false then true. It passes on bash, Git Bash, PS 5.1 and pwsh 7, and fails on 677d051a's wrappers.
Every refused re-join row (error, isError, malformed, foreign, unlisted, silent) asserts that no create_team call happens.
invariants: No other wrapper line changes; the message readers in moe_rpc, retry_team_join's python reader and Invoke-MoeRpcRaw stay untouched.
A refusal that does not contain 'Team not found: ' keeps TEAM_ID / $script:teamId, and the wrapper still warns once per changed refusal.
moe-agent.ps1 keeps its UTF-8 BOM, and the sh/ps1 twins pass parity-check.sh.
compatibility: No MCP contract or daemon change.
The substring also matches the unprefixed text, which no daemon ever sent, and a future '[TEAM_NOT_FOUND] ' prefix.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Four options were weighed.
(1) Match error.data.codeName === 'NOT_FOUND'. The ps1 reply object has it ($joined.error.data.codeName). But bash's python reader keeps only error.message, so bash would need a reader change outside the branch, which DoD 3 forbids. NOT_FOUND is also generic, and it becomes TEAM_NOT_FOUND if errors.ts SPECIFIC_NOT_FOUND_CODE_NAMES ever lists it.
(2) An exact prefix alternation ('[NOT_FOUND] Team not found: '* or 'Team not found: '*). It is precise, but breaks on the same codeName change.
(3) Chosen: a substring 'Team not found: ' in both twins. That is the text notFound('Team', id) always produces. It is robust to the prefix and the same in both twins. The unprefixed form never reached the wire: MoeError already prefixed it at f75f57b6, the commit that wrote the branch.
(4) Rejected: loosening the test's anchor to '\nif ($Team'. Slice anchors stay exact, so a moved line fails loudly.
